name: High Tide (VST3)
description: A wavetable synth that stores no waveforms either: every frame is a bowl on a sculpted terrain, and the sound is what a mass does when it is dropped into it, integrated by Newton's law at audio rate. A parabola is a sine; a pit in the floor is a pulse. A rising tide floods the passes between the valleys so the ball can be towed anywhere, and pins on a timeline put it exactly where you want it, when you want it there. A photograph makes a landscape of bowls.
note: Windows VST3 · build 261024.3 · free download · 17 starters + 12 terrains · hints on every control · 15-page manual.
